repos_data.description: Fast, local-first web content extraction for LLMs. Scrape, crawl, extract structured data — all from Rust. CLI, REST API, and MCP server.
Quickly reads webpages and converts to markdown for fast, token efficient web scraping
Web scraping MCP server for AI agents. Real Chrome, 84% success rate. 10 free calls/day, no signup.
⚙️ Convert HTML to Markdown. Even works with entire websites and can be extended through rules.

repo_meta_data.description: Fast, lightweight Firecrawl/Tavily alternative in Rust. Web scraper, crawler & search API with MCP server for AI agents. Drop-in Firecrawl-compatible API (/scrape, /crawl, /search). 2.3x faster than Tavily, 1.5x faster than Firecrawl in 1K-URL benchmarks. 6 MB RAM, single binary. Self-host or use managed cloud.
